question: In 2024, Air Marshal Tejinder Singh was appointed as the _______ at the Air Headquarters (Vayu Bhawan).

options.text: Deputy Chief of the Air Staff

solution:
The correct answer is __**Deputy Chief of the Air Staff**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In 2024, **Air Marshal Tejinder Singh** was appointed as the **Deputy Chief of the Air Staff** at the Air Headquarters (Vayu Bhawan).
 
• The** role of the Deputy Chief of the Air Staff (**DCAS) is crucial within the Indian Air Force (IAF).
 
• The DCAS is responsible for planning, procurement, and overseeing the modernization of the Air Force, including the induction of advanced technologies and equipment.
 
• This position is critical in maintaining the operational readiness of the IAF.
 
• The **Air Headquarters (Vayu Bhawan)**, located in New Delhi, is the central administrative office of the IAF, where key decisions regarding the force's operations, strategy, and modernization are taken.
